steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Gothic Definition: A genre that combines horror, death, romance and the supernatural. It explores what lies beneath the surface of civilization - our fears, desires and secrets. | Scientific Supernatural: Victorian Gothic often uses science to explain supernatural events. This reflects Victorian anxiety about science going too far - creating horrors through knowledge. | The Secret as Society: Gothic secrets reflect Victorian society's secrets - what respectable families hid behind closed doors. The secret reveals the hypocrisy beneath the surface. | Gothic Analysis Strategy: When writing about Gothic elements, the highest marks come from treating Gothic conventions as meaningful choices, not decorative features.
